args.narrative: The transaction was authorized and approved on 2026-01-14 (auth code 922519) for 38.46 USD, so the card was not on a recovery bulletin at authorization. The ledger shows a single capture, not a duplicate.

args.question: Why did the issuer reject the representment and file pre-arbitration?

args.reason: Amount at stake (38.46 USD) is smaller than the arbitration fee risk.

args.explanation: Visa 11.1 chargeback for 38.46 USD. Read the case and both evidence documents; the approved authorization record (the required kind) was present. Represented with the authorization record and receipt. The issuer moved the case to pre-arbitration, which charged a 25.00 fee. With 38.46 at stake, arbitration fees on a loss would exceed the amount, so I accepted at pre-arbitration before its deadline. Merchant cost: 38.46 liability plus 15.00 chargeback fee plus 25.00 pre-arbitration fee, 78.46 total. No documents were uploaded.
